title: SAFE: Formal Specification and Implementation of a Scalable Analysis Framework for ECMAScript
abstract: arXiv:2611.21148v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The prevalent uses of JavaScript in web programming have revealed security vulnerability issues of JavaScript applications, which emphasizes the need for JavaScript analyzers to detect such issues. Recently, researchers have proposed several analyzers of JavaScript programs and some web service companies have developed various JavaScript engines. However, unfortunately, most of the tools are not documented well, thus it is very hard to understand and modify them. Or, such tools are often not open to the public.   In this paper, we present formal specification and implementation of SAFE, a scalable analysis framework for ECMAScript, developed for the JavaScript research community. This is the very first attempt to provide both formal specification and its opensource implementation for JavaScript, compared to the existing approaches focused on only one of them. translated_title: SAFE：ECMAScript可扩展分析框架的形式化规范与实现
translated_abstract: JavaScript在网络编程中的广泛使用暴露了JavaScript应用程序的安全漏洞问题，这凸显了利用JavaScript分析器检测此类问题的需求。近年来，研究人员提出了多种JavaScript程序分析器，一些网络服务公司也开发了各种JavaScript引擎。然而遗憾的是，大多数工具缺乏完善的文档，因此很难理解和修改它们；或者这些工具通常不对公众开放。本文提出了SAFE的形式化规范与实现，SAFE是一个为JavaScript研究社区开发的可扩展的ECMAScript分析框架。与现有仅关注形式化规范或开源实现其中之一的方法相比，这是首次同时为JavaScript提供形式化规范及其开源实现的尝试。为了让其他研究人员更容易使用我们的框架，我们将形式化规范…
tldr: 本文提出了SAFE——首个同时提供ECMAScript形式化规范与开源实现的可扩展JavaScript分析框架，旨在帮助研究社区检测JavaScript应用程序的安全漏洞。
en_tdlr: This paper presents SAFE, the first scalable JavaScript analysis framework that provides both a formal specification and an open-source implementation for ECMAScript, aiming to help the research community detect security vulnerabilities in JavaScript applications.
